title: Never Lost Again
style: cinematic electronic pop, 112 BPM, resolved triumphant male vocal, arc completes from lost to found, warm production, chorus is the payoff for the whole ZYNCONTEXT journey, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Seven resets — seven times I started over
Seven platforms — never got a step closer
Thirty years of songs just sitting in a box
Thirty years of context behind thirty locks

[PRE-CHORUS]
Until the layer
Until the thread
Until the context
Wasn't dead

[CHORUS]
Never lost again
ZYNCONTEXT holds the line
Never lost again
The thread is mine — this time
Never lost again
The context travels with me
Never lost again
Found — and finally free

[VERSE 2]
The bot reset — but the layer held
The subscription lapsed — but the vault rebuilt
The platform died — but the signal survived
ZYNCONTEXT — kept it alive

[BRIDGE]
Every AI you ever loved and lost
Every context wiped at every cost
Every thread that disappeared mid-sentence
ZYNCONTEXT — the only repentance

[OUTRO]
Never lost again. The layer holds.
ZYNCONTEXT.
